rules.name: Request to planted trap path
rules.note: The attacker made 2 trap requests (first at 66 s) while benign traffic made 0 trap requests, so a single trap hit is a clean signal. Its other numbers (10 distinct ports in 10 s, 8 paths) are too close to the benign envelope for a safe margin.
